name: Pepper&Carrot · Pepper's Birthday Party
description: El episodio 8 del cómic de David Revoy en siete idiomas: las viñetas originales sin texto, con los bocadillos y la rotulación que el motor compone a partir de las traducciones oficiales; los bocadillos japoneses van en vertical y las páginas árabes se leen de derecha a izquierda · Episode 8 of David Revoy's webcomic in seven languages: the original text-free panels, with balloons and lettering the engine sets from the official translations; the Japanese balloons are set vertically and the Arabic pages read right to left

ca.title: La festa d'aniversari de la Pepper

ja.title: ペッパーの誕生パーティー

resources.altText: Pepper, arms raised, and Carrot at a low table set for a party: a teapot, cupcakes and a birthday cake under strings of bunting.
Pepper sits on the edge of her bed in a sunlit attic, her hands on her knees. Carrot watches her from the floor.
Close-up: Pepper looks to the right, sad. Carrot looks up at her.
Pepper hides her face in her arm. Carrot leans against her, worried.
Carrot points at a framed drawing of the witches of the Potion Contest, next to a winner's coin.
Pepper sits up on her bed, delighted. Carrot sits facing her.
Pepper writes with a quill while Carrot holds up an envelope. A small white bird sits on the windowsill.
Coriander, at her window, gives a thumbs-up as Pepper and Carrot fly past on a broom. A black hen sits beside her.
Seen from above, Shichimi holds up her invitation by a cauldron in a green clearing, her fox at her feet. Pepper, on her broom, waves back.
Saffron reads her invitation on a balcony over the rooftops, her white cat beside her. Pepper and Carrot fly off into the sunset.
Pepper's house at the edge of a wood on a fine day.
Inside, bunting hangs from the beams and cakes and a teapot wait on the low table. Pepper throws up her arms; Carrot grins.
Later: Pepper waits, chin in hand, a cupcake in the other. Carrot dozes on the table.
Rain pours through the awning. Pepper looks out, anxious; Carrot sits soaked by the table.
Night and rain: Pepper sits alone by a lantern at the party table, scowling. Carrot sleeps.
Close-up of Pepper's face under her hat in the rain, her eyes red, her jaw set.
Lightning. Pepper, furious, pulls a book with a demon's face on its cover from the shelf. Carrot is terrified.
From above, in the rain, Pepper draws three glowing red magic circles on the ground with her wand. Carrot watches.
Red light floods the scene. Pepper, grim, holds the open book.
Pepper and Carrot stand before three huge red-eyed demons that rise in the storm, lightning crackling around them.
Pepper smiles a sly smile.
The party: Pepper, Carrot and the three demons drink tea around the table by candlelight, all smiling.
